message: No detected input validation: The code reads edge lists and node labels from files and parses them with basic map/int conversions, but there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local files and via DGL's TUDataset without any checksum verification, signed URLs, or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation code performs only basic parsing and reindexing of graph edges and labels with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code includes a --resume argument for loading checkpoints, but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision verification when loading the checkpoint file.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No DP libraries (Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no isolation of a held-out test set from training, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code processes graph data directly via DGL batching without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs before passing them to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation are applied to model outputs anywhere in the visible inference-related code paths.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a graph neural network pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
